{{Recipe}}

{{recipesummary
| Category = Dessert recipes
| Servings = 8
| Time = 90 minutes (40 minutes active kitchen time, 50 minutes cooking time)
| Difficulty = 3
| Energy = 
| Rating = 
}}'''Baklava''' is a Mediterranean dessert consisting of layers of phyllo dough interspersed with crushed nuts and soaked in sweet syrup. 

This recipe is modified from one at Allrecipes.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Baklava |url=https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/9454/greek-baklava/ |access-date=2025-11-17 |website=Allrecipes |language=en}}</ref> 

== Ingredients ==

* 1 lb (450 g) [[Cookbook:Nuts and Seeds|nuts]] (any type, but preferrably [[Cookbook:Pistachio|pistachios]] or [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]])
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (5 ml) ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Phyllo Dough|phyllo dough]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Liter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 1 tsp (5 ml) [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]
* ⅓ cup (80 ml) [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* ⅔ cup (160 ml) [[Cookbook:Sugar|white sugar]]
* ¾ cup (180 ml) water

== Procedure ==

# Combine the nuts and cinnamon in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]]. Blend the nuts into a fine powder, being careful not to form a paste. 
# Melt the butter in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium heat, then set aside.
# Line a [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]] with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]].
# Count the number of sheets of phyllo dough and divide it by eight. Arrange one-eighth of the sheets in the bottom of the pan, on the parchment paper.
# Divide the chopped nuts into seven equally sized portions.
# Brush the phyllo dough with melted butter, and evenly distribute one portion of chopped nuts over the dough.
# Arrange another eighth of the phyllo sheets on top of the nut layer.
# Repeat the buttering and layering of nuts and phyllo until you have used up all the phyllo sheets and chopped nuts.
# Using a sharp knife, radially cut the baklava into eight equally sized portions shaped like the British flag.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] the baklava for 25 minutes at 350°F (180°C). Remove from the oven, and let cool slightly.
# Mix the vanilla extract, honey, sugar, and water in a clean saucepan. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] over medium heat until it becomes a very thick and viscous syrup of slightly over 1 cup (240 ml). Remove from the heat, and let cool slightly. 
# Pour the syrup on top of the baked baklava, coating each portion of the baklava evenly with syrup.
# Let everything cool fully before serving.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Do not pour the syrup until both the baklava and the syrup are cool to avoid burns.
